spec.situation_desc: had their savings interest rate cut without noticing any letter

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Liam speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I'm Imran Okonkwo. I've just noticed the interest rate on my savings account has been cut. I never saw a letter about it, and honestly, I'm really unhappy with how the bank's handled this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry to hear that, Imran. I can look into the rate change for you. Before I discuss the account, could you confirm your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that's verified. Which savings account is it, and when did you notice the change?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: The Easy Saver. I checked yesterday and it's gone from 4.1 per cent to 2.8. I don't understand why I wasn't told.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see why that would be frustrating. Don't worry, we'll get the difference back into your account.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I hope so. It feels like the bank just changed it and expected me not to notice.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll have a look at the rate history and the notification details. You should hear back within five working days.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Is there anything you'll do about me not receiving a letter?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'll put a note on the account that you didn't receive one, and the team can review the details.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right, but I'm still not happy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand, and I'm sorry this has been such a frustrating experience. Just to summarise, the rate change and notification will be reviewed, and you'll hear back within five working days. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, that makes sense. I just want to know why it happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Of course. Thanks for your patience, Imran.
